visual.name: bfusionTaskKPIBoard
visual.description: Task-level status KPI board: counts, in-progress, late, overdue, off-track tasks, scheduled effort, health bar, and smart attention insights — designed for OnePlan / Project Online task data.

dataRoles.name: taskCount
dataRoles.description: Total number of tasks in scope. Bind [Task Count].

dataRoles.name: inProgress
dataRoles.description: Tasks currently in progress. Bind [Tasks - In Progress].

dataRoles.name: activeLate
dataRoles.description: In-progress tasks past their due date. Bind [Tasks - Active Late Tasks].

dataRoles.name: overdue
dataRoles.description: Past-due and incomplete tasks. Bind [Tasks - Overdue Tasks].

dataRoles.name: offTrack
dataRoles.description: Tasks flagged as off track by status. Bind [Tasks - Off Track Tasks].

dataRoles.name: scheduledEffort
dataRoles.description: Sum of scheduled effort across tasks (hrs). Bind [Scheduled Effort].

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

warnPct.description: Attention % at which the badge turns amber

criticalPct.description: Attention % at which the badge turns red

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
